## Arrays promoted out of JSONB

### `guest_scan_observations` — from `guest_scans.result.observations`

dentalScanAnalytics.service.js:216 and :240 both unwind $result.observations and group by .type and .confidence. Two independent aggregations over the same array is the clearest signal in the codebase that it is an entity rather than a detail of its parent.

### `subscription_invoice_history` — from `subscriptions.invoiceHistory`

productOwner.service.js:306 unwinds $invoiceHistory and filters on invoiceHistory.paidAt and .status to build the monthly revenue trend. Range-filtering a date inside a JSONB array cannot use a normal btree index; as a column it can.

### `invoice_items` — from `invoices.items`

Statutory. billing.service.js:1094 unwinds $items to build the HSN-wise GST summary, grouping by items.hsnCode and summing tax per line. That is a tax filing figure, and the plan names aggregation rewrites the highest defect risk in the programme (phase 5). A typed child table makes it an ordinary GROUP BY that the database can index; over JSONB it is a hand-written jsonb_array_elements that nothing checks.

- `promotion_applicable_plans` — `promotions.applicablePlans` -> Plan (array of ObjectId references — promoted so the relationship is enforced)
- `promotion_target_clinics` — `promotions.targetClinics` -> Clinic (array of ObjectId references — promoted so the relationship is enforced)
- `rebate_applicable_plans` — `rebates.applicablePlans` -> Plan (array of ObjectId references — promoted so the relationship is enforced)
- `clinic_holiday_branches` — `clinic_holidays.branches` -> Branch (array of ObjectId references — promoted so the relationship is enforced)
- `insurance_claim_payments` — `insurance_claims.payments` -> Payment (array of ObjectId references — promoted so the relationship is enforced)
- `invoice_payments` — `invoices.payments` -> Payment (array of ObjectId references — promoted so the relationship is enforced)
